EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: MOR/LAN/01/F1/201. Tourism & Land Ministry No.: 4-3/4/2013/D/392. I hereby give notice, under Sub–section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for location of Thelawala, Salusala Land for the Police Special Task Force. Description of the Lands to be acquired: Allotment of Land in extent of 0.7937 Hectare depicted in Sheet No. 09 of the block 01 of the Cadastral Map No. 520211 dated 08.02.2024 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Thelawala in the Grama Niladhari Divisions of Borupana in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Moratuwa in Colombo District of the Western Province described as follows. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land : Lady Catherine Group, Borupana Road; Present Land Use : Garden, Bodhiya, three

permanent buildings, five toilets and a water tank; Ownership : Cannot be found; Extent : 0.7937 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Moratuwa Divisional Secretariat, on 27th November 2024 at 10.00 a.m and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing ( in duplicate) on or before the 06th November 2024, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and relevant documents is support of claim should be provided at the inquiry. S. P. KIRIWATHTHUDUWA, Divisional Secretary, Moratuwa. At Divisional Secretariat, Moratuwa. On 15th of August, 2024 EOG 09-0029
